messages.subject: Re: [D-RUG]: Joining Adjacency Matrices
parts:
Rich

Just made a proposal on SO. Copying/paste answer there, what I suggested is
  1. turn the matrices into individual pair-matrices (i.e. pair-value), i.e. to long
  2. bind them,
  3. decide what to do for repeated pairs (here I just take first value...)
  4. then spread to wide back.
